notes: Reviewed unchanged: every unit in the accepted alignment survives the check, and no edge, status or head was altered.

Partition verified: s001-s018 and t001-t020 each appear exactly once, no invented IDs, every aligned unit has nonempty source and target with both heads inside their arrays, and both unrepresented units are source-only with a valid source head and a null target head.

The two unrepresented articles rest on different rules and both were re-tested. s006 is rule 20 displacement, and rule 76's availability test confirms it: hemon carries only 'our' and has not been spent on any other role, so the possessive has a source word to belong to. s013 is rule 23, the ASV writing no determiner at all before 'mercies'; rule 21 explicitly forbids leaving a bare 'of' on such an article, so the case preposition stays on the noun in both cases. A reference comparison may report either article as a disagreement; neither is a correction.

s001's copula placement was checked against rule 63 rather than rule 53 alone, since the subject is a lexical noun phrase rather than a pronoun. Rule 53's noun-phrase exception is scoped to a subject pronoun, so 'be' stays with the predicate adjective and is not read off the ASV's word order.

The marginal reading 'Or, God and the Father' would move the s002 article's construal onto pater, but rule 12 bars a new textual decision inside the alignment file; the projection was aligned as supplied and the note recorded here only.
